findings.observation: Vision analysis of Sheet 19 profiles shows water/wastewater crossings: At STA 1+20.14 on WT-02 profile, proposed 8" fire water line (FL 546.96) crosses existing 12" PVC wastewater line (FL 547.07), with the wastewater line 0.11 feet ABOVE the water line. At STA 1+29.66 on WW-01 profile, proposed 12" wastewater (FL 525.68) crosses existing 12" water line with note 'CONTRACTOR TO FIELD VERIFY' but no existing water elevation given. A detail note references 'STEEL ENCASEMENT WITH SPACERS SEE CONSTRUCTION DETAILS' but no leaders connect it to specific crossings. No notes cite TCEQ Chapter 290 or 217 requirements for crossings.

TCEQ regulations (Ch. 290.44(c)(2)) require water lines to be above wastewater lines at crossings with minimum 18" vertical separation (or 12" with proper casing). The observed crossing at STA 1+20.14 shows wastewater ABOVE water (0.11' separation), which violates TCEQ requirements. While an encasement detail is mentioned, specific TCEQ compliance details (vertical separation, water-over-wastewater configuration, encasement specifications) are not adequately shown at the crossings. This is a technical compliance issue that must be resolved.
findings.explanation: TCEQ crossing compliance details not adequately shown; STA 1+20.14 shows wastewater above water line, violating TCEQ Ch. 290 requirement
findings.resolution: Add TCEQ crossing compliance details to Sheet 19 at all water/wastewater crossings. Show vertical separation dimensions, ensure water lines cross above wastewater lines per TCEQ Ch. 290.44(c)(2), and provide casing/encasement details. Revise WT-02 profile at STA 1+20.14 to show compliant crossing configuration with water above wastewater and minimum 18-inch separation (or 12-inch with proper casing). Reference TCEQ Ch. 290 and 217 requirements in notes.
